Papers are organized by status:

1. **Accepted (Peer-Reviewed Journal Articles):** Full citation, DOI, slide decks, technical one-pagers, and public reproduction repositories.
2. **In review:** Submitted manuscripts currently under peer review (title, authors, target journal, and abstract).
3. **Work-in-progress:** Active pre-submission research listed strictly by internal project code (`Pub_xxx`) and a one-sentence topic description.
